symptom: Sending a message in the Agent panel stalls visibly before the user bubble appears because the main process rescans all skill directories twice (~1,800 FS calls), unconditionally fsyncs the approval policy file, deep-clones the model catalog and re-parses availableModels with Zod on every send, and ships full successful tool-result JSON over IPC.
direct_cause: discoverSkillRecords always rescans every skill root from scratch; writeAgentApprovalPolicy writes and fsyncs even when policy mode is unchanged; selectModel invokes readCatalog() structuredClone and parseLaneComposerContext re-runs Zod on unchanged availableModels; laneIpc forwards full non-error tool-result text unused by the renderer.
class_root: Missing source-truth invalidation and boundary payload shaping at the shared main-process boundaries (skill catalog discovery, approval policy writer, model/composer admission, and lane IPC projection push).
affected_population: All desktop creators sending messages in the Agent panel, especially in multi-turn tool-heavy conversations or under disk/CPU contention
entry_points: Agent panel send -> nomi:agent-lane:command (prompt/steer/follow-up) -> dependencies.configure + skillIndex.refresh + laneIpc projection push
Direct callers of discoverSkillRecords, readSkillRecords, writeAgentApprovalPolicy, parseLaneComposerContext, and trimWorkspaceProjectionForIpc

external_sources.purpose: Confirm Node.js fs/promises.lstat({ bigint: true }) nanosecond mtimeNs/ctimeNs/ino metadata semantics for single-mechanism skill directory fingerprinting

invariants: Unchanged skill roots reuse the cached SkillDiscoveryResult with zero SKILL.md reads; adding a skill, editing SKILL.md frontmatter, deleting a skill, or swapping a symlink invalidates on the very next refresh.
writeAgentApprovalPolicy performs zero disk writes and zero fsyncSync calls when the normalized policy mode equals the current effective policy, and writes atomically when the mode actually changes.
selectModel reuses cached model selection while catalogRevisionToken() and model preference are unchanged, and re-resolves immediately on catalog byte change or locked credentials.
parseLaneComposerContext reuses deep-frozen validated availableModels only on exact plain-value structural equality, preserving strict fail-closed Zod rejection on any mutation or invalid field.

trimWorkspaceProjectionForIpc strips text on successful (isError: false) tool-result parts at the IPC boundary while preserving error tool-result text, failure envelopes, nextAction, and in-process lane.projection() completeness.

door_reduction.why_not: The six entries own distinct responsibilities along the send pipeline (skill directory discovery, approval policy persistence, desktop runtime configuration, composer context parsing, IPC projection shaping, and IPC channel push); each invariant is enforced at its single shared boundary rather than duplicated across callers.

generality_proof: Because every skill refresh in the desktop process flows through discoverSkillRecords, every policy write flows through writeAgentApprovalPolicy, every send model/context resolution flows through laneDesktopRuntime/laneDesktopInput, and every renderer projection push flows through laneIpc, enforcing invalidation and trimming at those four boundaries covers prompt, steer, follow-up, and all repeated refreshes within a turn without touching laneHost.mts.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own skill directory tree discovery with a single-slot last-result memo validated solely by recursive nanosecond lstat/readdir tree fingerprinting.
Own approval policy persistence as the sole idempotency check, skipping atomic backup/fsync when normalized mode is unchanged.
Cache text model resolution against catalogRevisionToken() and delegate policy persistence directly to writeAgentApprovalPolicy.
Skip redundant Zod re-validation of unchanged availableModels while keeping strict validation fail-closed.
Strip renderer-unused non-error tool-result text while preserving error text and structured envelopes.
Apply trimWorkspaceProjectionForIpc at the single IPC projection push boundary.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Both configure and setPolicy route policy persistence through writeAgentApprovalPolicy and model resolution through catalogRevisionToken()-keyed selectModel.
All skillIndex.refresh() calls (startup, laneHost:625 admission, laneHost:276 systemPromptForRun) converge on discoverSkillRecords.
Every workspace projection pushed to WebContents passes through trimWorkspaceProjectionForIpc.
In-process lane.projection() retains full tool-result text for tests and host assertions; trimming is scoped strictly to the renderer IPC boundary.

recurrence.reason: Any growth in bundled/user skills or multi-turn tool-result history amplifies send latency on every Agent message across all users and machines.
same_class_scan: Audited all 11 readSkillRecords callers via scripts/door-map.mjs; all converge on discoverSkillRecords.
Audited all writeAgentApprovalPolicy callers via scripts/door-map.mjs (1 door, 2 sites in laneDesktopRuntime.ts).
Audited all tool-result part.text readers across src/, electron/, and tests/ via git grep; confirmed renderer laneViewModel.ts reads part.text only when part.isError is true.

prevention.invariant: Hot-path send boundaries must reuse validated/discovered state when underlying source truth has not changed and must not transmit renderer-unused tool-result bodies over IPC.
prevention.failure_mode: Any detected filesystem fingerprint change, catalog revision change, or schema mismatch immediately invalidates memoized state and falls back to full fresh evaluation.
prevention.strategy: Enforce source-truth caching and IPC projection trimming at the four shared boundaries, guarded by FS-count/invalidation unit tests and registered 50-turn tool-heavy + 100-item plain-text performance scenarios.

legacy_paths.rationale: No legacy parallel path was introduced; existing boundaries were upgraded in place without fallbacks.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Relies solely on Node.js built-in fs/promises.lstat / readdir and existing catalogRevisionToken(); no external cache or watcher dependency is added.

migration: No on-disk schema or user data migration is required; existing skill directories, approval policy JSON files, and pi JSONL sessions continue to work identically.
residual_risks: First message after project open still upgrades openLaneHistory to openLane (configureModel -> openLaneNativeDesktop) to avoid moving 450-1200ms cold native assembly onto project-open startup.
Renderer still waits for main-process JSONL persistence before mounting the user bubble (optimistic echo D3-11 is deferred to a separate coordinator decision).
